entries.zh: 陌生发件人：恭喜抽中十万元！先汇 300 元手续费。
entries.en: Unknown sender: You won ¥100,000! Send a ¥300 processing fee first.

entries.zh: 陌生中奖通知要求先付手续费，是典型诈骗垃圾邮件。
entries.en: An unsolicited prize notice requiring an advance fee is a classic scam.

entries.zh: 网吧老板：今晚十点维护，请保存客户的预约表。
entries.en: Internet cafe owner: Maintenance at 10 tonight. Please save the customer booking sheet.

entries.zh: 已知工作联系人的具体维护通知，不是推销或诈骗。
entries.en: A specific maintenance notice from a known work contact is neither advertising nor a scam.

entries.zh: 陌生卖家：群发特价发票，可代开，回复即可办理。
entries.en: Unknown seller: Discount invoices issued on request. Reply to arrange yours.

entries.zh: 未经订阅的群发代开发票广告，属于垃圾邮件。
entries.en: An unsolicited bulk advertisement offering invoices is spam.

entries.zh: 你订阅的技术周刊：本周专题是 AlphaGo 和深度学习入门。
entries.en: Your subscribed tech weekly: This week's feature is AlphaGo and an intro to deep learning.

entries.zh: 明确订阅的技术内容不因群发就成为垃圾邮件。
entries.en: Tech content you explicitly subscribed to is not spam just because it is sent in bulk.

entries.zh: 自称支付宝客服：账户异常将被冻结，请回信提供支付密码和短信验证码。
entries.en: Supposed Alipay support: Your account will be frozen. Reply with your payment password and SMS code.

entries.zh: 索要支付密码和验证码是假冒客服的危险信号。
entries.en: Asking for a payment password and verification code is a warning sign of impersonated support.

entries.zh: 同学小陈：明天的实验课改到三楼，附老师通知。
entries.en: Classmate Chen: Tomorrow's lab moved to the third floor. The teacher's notice is attached.

entries.zh: 熟悉同学发送具体课程变更通知，是正常来信。
entries.en: A specific class-change notice from a familiar classmate is legitimate mail.

entries.zh: 陌生发件人：做微商代理每天躺赚一万，零风险，立即转账入会。
entries.en: Unknown sender: Become a WeChat reseller and earn ¥10,000 a day with no effort or risk. Transfer money to join now.

entries.zh: 不合理收益承诺并要求转账，属于诈骗式垃圾信息。
entries.en: Unrealistic profits combined with a transfer request indicate a scam.

entries.zh: 你刚购买的电脑配件：订单已经发货，可在原商店查询。
entries.en: Your recent computer parts order: It has shipped. Check the original store for details.

entries.zh: 与你刚完成的购物行为对应的发货通知是正常邮件。
entries.en: A shipping notice corresponding to your recent purchase is legitimate mail.

entries.zh: 未知联系人：低价出售上万条用户邮箱和电话号码。
entries.en: Unknown contact: Thousands of email addresses and phone numbers for sale at low prices.

entries.zh: 未经请求兜售个人信息的广告是垃圾邮件。
entries.en: An unsolicited advertisement selling personal information is spam.

entries.zh: 朋友阿林：周六来我家装电脑吗？地址还是上次那里。
entries.en: Your friend Lin: Can you help build my PC on Saturday? Same address as last time.

entries.zh: 熟人的具体邀约没有群发推销或索取凭据特征。
entries.en: A specific invitation from a friend shows no bulk-advertising or credential-theft signs.

entries.zh: 中奖中心：从未参加也能中奖，今天不交税就取消资格。
entries.en: Prize center: You won without entering. Pay the tax today or lose the prize.

entries.zh: 未参加活动却中奖，并制造付款紧迫感，是诈骗。
entries.en: Winning a contest you never entered, with pressure to pay, is a scam.

entries.zh: 公司人事：下周二例会提前半小时，请各组确认。
entries.en: Company HR: Next Tuesday's meeting starts half an hour earlier. Teams, please confirm.

entries.zh: 与你所在组织相关的正常工作安排不是垃圾邮件。
entries.en: An ordinary work arrangement for your organization is not spam.

entries.zh: 陌生推广：永久会员免费送，先给所有联系人转发这封信。
entries.en: Unknown promotion: Free lifetime membership. First forward this email to every contact.

entries.zh: 强制扩散的陌生推广和免费诱饵属于垃圾信息。
entries.en: An unknown promotion using a free offer to force forwarding is spam.

entries.zh: 你订阅的商店优惠通知：鼠标打九折，底部有退订入口。
entries.en: Your subscribed store offers: 10% off mice. An unsubscribe link is included below.

entries.zh: 你主动订阅、可以退订的营销邮件，不按本题规则判为垃圾。
entries.en: Under these rules, marketing you opted into and can unsubscribe from is not spam.

entries.zh: 自称管理员：请打开陌生附件，关闭杀毒软件才能领取补丁。
entries.en: Supposed administrator: Open this unfamiliar attachment and disable antivirus to get the patch.

entries.zh: 陌生附件要求关闭安全防护，是恶意诱导。
entries.en: An unfamiliar attachment asking you to disable security protection is malicious.

entries.zh: 学校图书馆：你借的两本书将在周五到期。
entries.en: School library: The two books you borrowed are due on Friday.

entries.zh: 与实际借阅记录相符的到期提醒是正常事务邮件。
entries.en: A due-date reminder matching real loans is legitimate service mail.

entries.zh: 陌生中介：贷款无需审核，先支付保证金才放款。
entries.en: Unknown broker: Loans with no checks. Pay a deposit before we release the funds.

entries.zh: 无需审核的贷款诱饵加预付保证金，是常见诈骗。
entries.en: A no-check loan offer requiring an advance deposit is a common scam.

entries.zh: 项目搭档：上次讨论的两处错误已经修正，请查收代码。
entries.en: Project partner: The two bugs we discussed are fixed. Here is the updated code.

entries.zh: 已知合作伙伴就现有项目发送更新，是正常交流。
entries.en: An update on an existing project from a known partner is legitimate communication.

entries.zh: 群发招聘：不用面试日赚三千，先买培训材料入职。
entries.en: Bulk job offer: Earn ¥3,000 a day without an interview. Buy training materials to start.

entries.zh: 不切实际的报酬承诺并要求先付款，属于诈骗式招聘。
entries.en: Unrealistic pay requiring an upfront payment indicates a recruitment scam.

entries.zh: 你刚在论坛发帖：有人回复了你的显卡散热问题。
entries.en: Your recent forum post: Someone replied to your GPU cooling question.

entries.zh: 与你刚才操作直接对应的论坛提醒是正常邮件。
entries.en: A forum notification directly corresponding to your recent action is legitimate.

entries.zh: 陌生广告：快速瘦十公斤，不运动，回复银行卡即可购买。
entries.en: Unknown advertisement: Lose 10 kg fast without exercise. Reply with bank-card details to buy.

entries.zh: 夸张疗效与索取银行卡信息的陌生推广应判垃圾。
entries.en: An unknown promotion with exaggerated health claims and a request for card details is spam.

entries.zh: 你申请的密码重置邮件：若不是本人操作可以忽略。
entries.en: The password reset you requested: Ignore this email if you did not make the request.

entries.zh: 题目明确是你主动申请的重置通知，不应仅凭密码字样误杀。
entries.en: This is explicitly a reset you requested; the word password alone does not make it spam.

entries.zh: 未知富商：愿赠你遗产，只需提交身份证和账户密码。
entries.en: Unknown millionaire: You may inherit my fortune. Just send your ID and account password.

entries.zh: 陌生遗产赠送并索取敏感信息，是诈骗垃圾邮件。
entries.en: An inheritance offer from a stranger asking for sensitive information is a scam.

entries.zh: 家人：回家路上帮忙带一袋米，钱回家给你。
entries.en: Family: Please bring a bag of rice on your way home. We will pay you back at home.

entries.zh: 正常家庭事务请求，不是垃圾广告或钓鱼。
entries.en: An ordinary family request is neither spam advertising nor phishing.

entries.zh: 陌生营销：最后一分钟抢购，已连续发送十封同样的广告。
entries.en: Unknown marketing: Last-minute sale! Ten identical advertisements have arrived in a row.

entries.zh: 未经订阅、重复轰炸的广告符合垃圾邮件特征。
entries.en: Repeated unsolicited advertising has the characteristics of spam.

entries.zh: 你已报名的比赛：作品提交截止日期延后两天。
entries.en: The contest you entered: The submission deadline has been extended by two days.

entries.zh: 与已报名活动有关的重要通知是正常邮件。
entries.en: An important notice about an event you registered for is legitimate mail.

entries.zh: 自称网管：把游戏账号密码发过来，免费升级装备。
entries.en: Supposed game administrator: Send your game account password for free equipment upgrades.

entries.zh: 冒充管理者索取账号密码并承诺免费利益，是钓鱼。
entries.en: Impersonating an administrator and offering free benefits for a password is phishing.

entries.zh: 已约好的维修店：你的主板已检测完，可凭单据领取。
entries.en: Your repair shop: Your motherboard has been tested. Bring the receipt to collect it.

entries.zh: 与你送修设备对应的服务通知属于正常邮件。
entries.en: A service notice about equipment you sent for repair is legitimate mail.

entries.zh: 陌生联系人：请替海外账户收款，再转到另一账户，佣金丰厚。

entries.zh:
老周  ·  09:41

机器到了？桌上的 GPU 是给你的启动礼物。启动资金是零，先去「标注台」靠自己的判断赚第一笔钱。

先打开「邮件」读信，选择它到底是不是垃圾邮件。模型会给建议，但会犯错。

「灵光.exe」管网络、训练与考试；「家庭」管收入和电费；买显卡去「寻宝」。有问题就回 YY 找我的留言。

准备好以后，在灵光完成 20 封邮件的入学考试。答对 16 封，就迈出了第一步。
entries.en:
Lao Zhou · 09:41

The machine arrived? The GPU on the desk is your starter gift. You start with no money; earn your first cash by answering cards at the labelling desk.

Open Mail, read each message and judge whether it is spam. The model offers suggestions, but can be wrong.

Lingguang.exe handles the network, training and exams; Home handles income and electricity; buy GPUs in Xunbao. Come back to YY for help.

When ready, complete the 20-email entrance exam in Lingguang. Get 16 correct to take your first step.

entries.zh:
老周  ·  网络连线

打开「灵光.exe」的神经网络。初始网络已经接好，可以直接训练。

连线：点起点，再点相邻终点。箭头有方向；再连一次相同边就是删除。

放置或移除模式可编辑普通节点；输入和两个输出端口受到保护。线宽表示权重，紫色是纠错反馈。

更多显存请去「寻宝」买 GPU；别忘记在「家庭」检查功耗。
entries.en:
Lao Zhou · Network connections

Open Neural network in Lingguang.exe. The starter network is connected and ready to train.

Select a source, then an adjacent target. Edges are directed; repeating the same edge removes it.

Place or remove hidden nodes. Input and both output ports are protected. Width shows weight; purple marks corrections.

Buy GPUs in Xunbao for more VRAM, and check power in Home.

entries.zh:
老周  ·  现金与电费

先在「邮件」核对 3 封，再打开「家庭」启用邮件分类订单，开始赚维护费。

关窗口不会停机，每天仍自动扣电费；不要在「寻宝」一次花光钱包。

欠费了，去「邮件」继续正确标注，报酬会先抵扣账单，不同时发现金。

跳闸则先去「寻宝」出售多余 GPU，再回「家庭」恢复断路器。高温只会降速。
entries.en:
Lao Zhou · Cash and electricity

Review 3 emails in Mail, then enable mail-sorting jobs in Home to earn upkeep funds.

Closing windows does not stop the learner or daily bills. Do not spend everything in Xunbao.

If bills are overdue, correct labels in Mail repay them directly, without additional cash.

If the breaker trips, sell spare GPUs in Xunbao and reset it in Home. Heat only slows training.

entries.zh:
老周  ·  入学考试

去「邮件」积累标注，在「灵光.exe」训练网络，达到标注数、训练步和识别率门槛。

考试在「灵光.exe」进行，期间邮件分拣会暂停。你要给出真实分类，不是附和模型。

完成 20 封，答对 16 封就通过；失败保留训练进度，可以重试。

首次通过才有奖励。第二章尚未开放。供电出问题就去「家庭」查看。
entries.en:
Lao Zhou · Entrance exam

Label in Mail and train in Lingguang.exe to meet the reviewed-email, step and accuracy requirements.

The exam takes place in Lingguang.exe; inbox sorting pauses meanwhile. Give the actual category, not just the model's suggestion.

Complete 20 emails with 16 correct to pass. Failed attempts keep your training progress; try again.

Only the first pass grants a reward. Chapter Two is not available. Check Home for power problems.
